resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Fixture delegates request and ignores cancellation; no actual network transport.
Creates JSON response/status from fixture literal; sparse successful DTOs can mask missing required runtime fields.
Creates fake-handler HttpClient at fixture.invalid with no real login token or host service.
Creates all-permission synthetic manager AppSession; no shift set here, tests use explicit context.
Path switch supplies menu/day/reports/treasury/inventory/coverage sparse read JSON, defaultemptyarray for any unknown route. This permissive default can hide new unexpected requests.
Ten module/path cases fail one secondary read then retry success; asserts actual failurehit andLoadError lifecycle viareflection. Empty successfuldata doesnot prove populatedbinding correctness.
503 blockerread despitevalidday mustdisableclose; afterretryemptyblockers allowsclose. Tests fail-closed readpath, notserveratomicclose recheck.
Reportexpenses503 mustsetLoadError/HasDatafalse rather than showzero. Supports viewHasData hiding; othersectionfailuresseparate.
Defaulttodayquery thenPreviousDay selects dayperiod and allrequests useyesterday. Pollhelperwaits atmost2seconds; no explicit successfulidleassertion beyond request/statechecks.
Selectslast7 andasserts everyrequestfromtoday-6/totoday; real7dayrange notduplicatedsingle day. Doesnotverifydataaggregation.
Pollsupto200times10ms whileloading/noData, returnswithoutthrowonexpiry. Callerassertions maycatchsomefailures but thishelperdoesnotguaranteeidle despitecomment.
Firstrequestgated, NextDay setsHasDatafalse, release then10old+10newqueries finalsuccess. Verifies snapshotcover/reload schedule; notcancellation orintermediateallfieldsatomicity.
SubscribesPropertyChanged forHasNoPending afteroverview+emptyselectedroute. Asserts notificationandflag; no physicalprinter/routehealth proof.
payroll_approve alone withreviewedrun yieldsCanAdvancefalse becausemanagementgate also required. Clientruleonly; serverauthorizationseparate.
control_center readpermission loadsdaybutCanControl/Closefalse; directnullchecklistcommandproducesnowrites. Nullparameter canitselfshortcircuit, so doesnotprove forgedvaliditemblocked independently.

Retainsconfirm/canceldecision andthreeidenticalrequestsafterloss/later422; oppositecommandnosend andstartnew/dismissblocked. InjectsLastCheckoutResult, thusdoesnotcoverUI005recoveredresultnull deadend.
Lookupreprint loss→403→success retainsbodyandblocksclose/edit/globalstateuntilresolved. DoesnotassertIncludeKitchenRoutesfalse orprocessrestartdiskclear, so UI011/UI012notrefuted.
SuccessfulcheckoutprintJobsQueuedtrue requiresonecheckout andnoprintPOST, clearcart/noPendingPrint/nonewarning, neworderready. Serveractuallyqueuedjobsassumedfixtureflag, nottestedtransaction.
Captureselectronicdecisionpath/body, loss→422→confirmedDTO; cancelcasealsogetsconfirmedshape, so testprimarilyidentityrelease notactualcancelledstate.
